walls.note: The wide face toward the quay with the gilt block (panoramas 003721/3722/3723 of 2018-05-08, 00073 of 2025-01-30).

items.where: tall stele of polished black stone, flat-topped with a thin lighter cap, on a low plinth slab
items.how: builder: boxes for plinth, stele and cap

items.where: gilt text block in the middle of the wide face (five lines) and a strip of gilt lines on the narrow left face
items.how: builder: five gilt line plates and a lettered date line on the wide face, six short plates on the narrow face; the wording is not legible at panorama resolution and is not invented

walls.note: Back (canal side): plain polished stone; not photographed from this side.

sources.name: Jewish WW2 resistance memorial (Amstel 1, unveiled 16 October 1988), descriptive text only
